verdict.rationale: LangGraph ships as an official, pip-installable Python library with documented programmatic APIs such as graph construction, stream/astream, checkpointers and interrupts, so developers can build directly against first-party code. The evidence does not show a dedicated official client SDK for the Agent Server API (only an OpenAPI spec and CLI) or SDKs in other languages. Missing for 10: documented official client SDK for the Agent Server/deployment API, multi-language SDK coverage (e.g. JS/TS), independent corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents.
LangGraph graphs expose the stream (sync) and astream (async) methods to yield streamed outputs as iterators.
In production, use a checkpointer backed by a database: from langgraph.checkpoint.postgres import PostgresSaver
